blocks.text: Warm Neutrals

Warm neutrals like soft taupe, warm beige, and gentle greige (a combination of gray and beige) are timeless choices that create an inviting and versatile backdrop for any home’s style. These colors exude elegance and sophistication, enhancing your home’s overall appeal. They also pair well with pops of color, making them an excellent base for adding accents.

blocks.text: Bright White

A classic favorite that never goes out of style, bright white instantly brightens up your home’s exterior, making it look clean, crisp, and welcoming. It’s a perfect choice for creating a striking contrast against colorful landscaping. White also gives a fresh, modern look to traditional homes and adds a touch of luxury to more contemporary designs.

blocks.text: Creamy White

For a softer alternative to pure white, creamy whites offer a subtle richness that complements natural elements like wood accents and greenery. They bring warmth and charm to your home’s facade. Creamy white is also a versatile choice that pairs well with warm and cool colors, making it an excellent option for those looking to add personality to their home’s exterior.

blocks.text: Front Doors That Pop

Make a bold statement with a popping front door in vibrant red, sunny yellow, deep teal, or any other eye-catching hue. A bright, colorful front door adds personality and character, instantly drawing attention and enhancing your home’s curb appeal. This trend is a great way to add some color without committing to painting the entire exterior.

blocks.text: Dark and Stormy

Moody dark colors like deep charcoal, rich navy, or dramatic black are trending for those who want to make a sophisticated impact. Paired with white trim, these hues create a striking and modern look. They also beautifully complement homes with stone or brick accents, adding depth and creating a timeless appeal.

blocks.text: Two-Tone

Experiment with two-tone exteriors by combining darker and lighter shades. This technique highlights architectural features and adds depth and dimension to your home’s appearance. It’s a versatile trend that works well with different styles of homes, from modern to traditional.

blocks.text: Dark Blue

Dark blues — from navy to indigo — evoke a sense of calm and elegance. They pair beautifully with various architectural styles and create a timeless appeal. Dark blue is also a fantastic option for those looking to add color to their home’s exterior without going too bright or bold.

blocks.text: Rustic Red

Rustic reds add a touch of nostalgia, bringing warmth and Americana charm to your home’s exterior. These colors are especially striking against lush green surroundings. They also pair well with natural wood accents, creating a cozy and inviting look.

blocks.text: Deep Green

Embrace nature with deep green tones that blend harmoniously with outdoor landscapes. These colors — from forest green to olive — create a serene and inviting atmosphere. They look stunning on traditional homes and mix well with natural stone or brick accents.

blocks.text: Cool Gray

Cool grays offer a sleek and contemporary look, perfect for modern homes. They provide a neutral yet sophisticated backdrop that complements any style. Cool grays also pair well with other cool tones — such as blues and greens — making them a versatile choice for homeowners looking to add color to their exterior.
